newsitem.title: USA: Cisco operating earnings gain better than expected.
newsitem.headline: Cisco operating earnings gain better than expected.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc. said Tuesday its fourth-quarter profit from operations rose 34 percent, matching Wall Street forecasts, on strong sales of its computer networking gear.

Cisco, the world's biggest maker of networking gear, said that excluding one-time charges, it earned $383.2 million, or 55 cents a share, in the period. In the year-ago quarter, the company had profit from operations of $286.2 million, or 42 cents a share.
Wall Street expected Cisco, based in San Jose, Calif., to earn 55 cents a share, according to Zacks Investment Research.
Revenue for the quarter ended July 26 rose 37 percent to $1.77 billion from $1.29 billion a year ago.
